maintainedSurfaces: public-facade release-kit assets and setup/support guidance
refreshTriggers: SemVer tag or release-manifest contract change
public release-kit asset or setup/support change tied to the exact released VSIX
release-procedure, ship-control, or docs-workbench publication contract change
strictSemverRule: after an exact release is published, the current published package line on main shall match that exact release line
when develop carries post-release work, the develop package line shall advance to the next exact release candidate before public-facing normalization continues
any later repo change intended for publication shall advance package.json and the top CHANGELOG.md heading to the next SemVer line before further normalization or publication
future sessions shall not treat an unreleased SemVer bump as complete until the matching public tag and public GitHub release are both published
future sessions shall not keep landing post-release changes on the previous exact release version number
future sessions shall not treat a burned exact release as the green release baseline for later publication

major: breaks or removes a governed public or maintainer contract on purpose
changes a default branch, release topology, or install/runtime expectation in a way that invalidates an already-published workflow
drops support for a previously governed surface
minor: adds a new governed capability or supported workflow without breaking the current exact released line
adds a new maintained surface that future releases are expected to support
patch: fixes or hardens an existing workflow, release rule, procedure, branch policy, or CI posture without breaking the exact released contract
normalizes exact main back into develop before the next candidate line opens
captures governance-only or documentation-package hardening for an existing product line
semverDecisionFramework.decisionRecordingRule: record the chosen bump rationale in the control plane before further publication or release normalization continues

explicitNonTriggers: benchmark-only diagnosis that does not affect a shipped release surface
local characterization-only evidence changes without a governed release claim
unrelated docs or feature notes that do not affect install or release truth

acceptedCurrentContractBoundaries.characterization: linux-headless-recursive-load / labview-cli-connection-failed after one CloseLabVIEW recovery attempt

refreshTriggers: benchmark harness logic, packet derivation, or benchmark consumer tooling changes
comparison-report runtime execution changes that can affect HARNESS-VHS-002 truth
governed Windows benchmark image contract change
governed Linux runtime or benchmark-image contract change
a release or public claim would otherwise imply changed benchmark truth
explicitNonTriggers: UI-only or docs-only work that does not alter benchmark surfaces
public release-kit changes that do not alter benchmark contracts
out-of-scope alternative Windows x86 provisioning that is not part of the current governed image contract
reopenTriggers: the current governed Windows benchmark image contract gains same-bitness x86 provisioning
the governed NI Linux runtime or benchmark-image contract changes enough to justify a new full-window proof attempt
another in-scope benchmark provider becomes accepted authority truth

promotionRules: release/* branches are cut from develop and merge to main plus back into develop
hotfix/* branches are cut from main and merge to main plus back into develop
exact SemVer tags are cut from main only after the protected main pipeline succeeds

feature/*: focused tests for the changed surface
affected documentation or design gates before merge to develop
develop: npm run design:gate:assert-complete for governance or architecture work
release/*: public-facade proof before merge to main
hotfix/*: exact released-line package audit before merge to main
main: exact SemVer tags only after merged main is green

prohibitedBypasses: execution-policy bypass that skips canonical execution-request validation
execution-policy bypass that skips governed provider hard stops
PowerShell ExecutionPolicy Bypass on governed benchmark-image or host-proof helper surfaces
